Industrial software, automation, and Industry 4.0 solutions for heavy-industry clients.
The nine EIS service lines will be listed here.
Custom Level 2, analytics, and decision-support software for heavy industry.

We design and build advanced software for heavy industries — especially steel, energy, and manufacturing. Our solutions span Level 2 systems, process data analytics, management dashboards, and decision-support tools. The goal is to raise productivity, cut energy consumption, and give plant management complete visibility of operations. Every system is custom-built to match the real conditions of the plant.
Tune lines, cut energy use, and improve KPIs like Tap-to-Tap Time.

Engineering services to optimise the performance of production lines: process analysis, tuning of operating parameters, reduction of electricity and gas consumption, and improvement of key indicators such as Tap-to-Tap Time in steelmaking. We integrate with PLCs and Level 1 systems to give operators tighter, more accurate control.
ML for prediction, fault detection, and predictive maintenance.

Advanced algorithms and machine learning applied to industrial prediction and optimisation: temperature forecasting, material-consumption prediction, fault detection, and predictive maintenance. The goal is to turn raw plant data into actionable insights for managers and operators.
Connect PLC, SCADA, ERP, and MES through OPC UA middleware.

We design and implement the communication layers between industrial systems (PLC, SCADA, ERP, MES). This includes a custom middleware — comparable in scope to Kepware — providing an OPC UA server and tag management. Data flows across the organisation in a standard, secure, and reliable way.
Feasibility, control-system design, ROI, and tender documentation.

Consulting for the design, optimisation, and execution of industrial projects: feasibility studies, control-system design, ROI analysis, and tender documentation. Focus on practical, executable solutions in real industrial conditions — not theory alone.
Real-time dashboards for production, energy, quality, and KPIs.

Real-time monitoring of production status, energy consumption, quality, and equipment performance. Professional dashboards let managers make fast, accurate decisions. Definition and tracking of key KPIs — Yield, Energy per Ton, Downtime — is a core capability.
IGBT, fuses, sensors, automation parts — sourced and supplied.

Sourcing and supply of industrial equipment: IGBT modules, industrial fuses, automation gear, sensors, and specialty parts. A supply network spanning Europe, China, the UAE, and Oman delivers competitive pricing and guaranteed authenticity.
Install, commission, train, and support — end to end.

End-to-end services from installation through commissioning to long-term support: testing, calibration, operator training, and maintenance. The goal is stable, uninterrupted operation in the industrial environment.
Connect, collect, analyse, automate — Industry 4.0 in practice.

Implementation of advanced digitalisation: equipment connectivity, real-time data acquisition, intelligent analytics, and automated decision-making. Positions clients with a future-ready roadmap and EIS as a next-generation industrial solutions provider.
